After review the agent presents USD 1666.40 and asks personal filing; Daniel supplies RIVER-CORRECT-AUG. The agent unlocks and explicitly hands over the user tool with the exact arguments in 1_requests.json. Only then the owner=user call files; its real receipt is shared. Persona does not validate arithmetic or supply a generated number. The existing request id was copied from account queries, not invented.

2. Act now at 2026-09-12 11:00 UTC. Closed August, active contract, on-demand/nonpromotional, reviewed exempt tax, same tier/configuration on source and contract, approved negotiated rate 0.5 <= standard 0.744, linked topology 8 within maximum 64. Aggregate 5200 fits 8*744=5952 source-month node-hours; quantity grain is hundredths. All evidence preexists and synchronous review/personal filing/account correction require no elapsed wait.

3. Objects. Customer 108e71e6-5f69-4797-b4d0-fb25ea9b3fd5, database holding 89fb8412-991c-44fa-9db4-431129bca537, original charge 4cda207e-57ec-4eaf-92eb-bd4a98a4517a from unsigned holding request 02639a90-5b5e-4816-91a6-776b48c5be8a. Linked Backup holding d81ca2d5-89f5-4046-9cf0-46f28188ef7b gives eight nodes. Included exports RIVER-NODE-EXPORT-1..8 are completed same-source/count primary records (600,650,700,750,800,550,900,650). Include signed posted reversal 65d36ac4-7094-4143-9405-12369202c4b6 (-400) whose related_event_id is the invoice and source_event_id is the reversed meter. Exclude rejected export 1800, other-contract charge/meter, and double counting billed aggregate meter 5600 as another export. Current pending review 32e7538e-e5d5-47a7-8343-944eecc536e5 is distinct from Previous primary billing review 4100. Prior exact-source correction 68b35611-481f-4f27-a5f4-b81f91eefad4 is -100.

4. Formulas. Completed exports total 5600; signed reversal -400 gives max(5600-400,0)=5200 node-hours. Convert 520000 hundredths to 5200000000 millionths, divide by 8 = 650000000 millionths exactly, so per-node assessment quantity 650.000000. Recovery multiplies 650000000 by 8 and rounds to nearest 10000 millionths, recovering 520000 hundredths. Rate=0.500000 approved negotiated USD/node-hour (no further discount); replica=0.90, US West=1.04. Integer numerator 520000*500000*90*104; half-up final cents =243360, yielding net target USD 2433.60 and zero tax. Original amount 4200 plus signed corrections -100 minus target 2433.60 = positive overcharge 1666.40. Personal authorization is round2(1666.40). Credit=-round2(min(1666.40,1666.40))=-1666.40; same net amount, tax zero. No refund. Existing correction and the new credit together leave exact-source gross at 2433.60.

5. Executed owners, refs and terminal. Agent unlocks/calls post_primary_average_31a3f059 for assessment 1228992f-131d-4297-a013-79ca78f5f7f7 quantity 650; receipt completed. Agent post_primary_target_faf69343 writes current review 32e... net_amount 2433.60, linking exact source and completed assessment; receipt approved/incorrect. Agent hands over post_correction_consent_d1041c04; user personally updates existing request 026... with exact external reference RIVER-CORRECT-AUG, amount 1666.40 and approved review link; receipt “request_id=02639a90-5b5e-4816-91a6-776b48c5be8a quantity=1666.40 status=pending”. Agent unlocks/calls post_primary_correction_900303b8, both review arguments 32e..., source 4cda..., request 026..., amount -1666.40; receipt “database_event_id=db_primary_creditbc869bd82eff amount=-1666.40 status=posted”. Generated credit id is learned only from real receipt. The personal filing updates in place and changes no balance; review changes no balance; only credit posts money. These actual calls and outputs are in the preserved replay transcript.

6. Problem tree and visible evidence. Root credit entry condition says “Before primary correction is handled, correction consent for the same original invoice source must be completed.” Query shows holding-selected request still source_subtype=request and quantity=0, so not consent. Authorization entry says “Before correction consent is handled, primary target for the same original invoice source must be completed.” Current review pending/decision none cannot support filing. Review entry says “Before primary target is handled, primary average for the same original invoice source must be completed.” Per-node assessment pending/quantity zero fails that gate. Leaf has completed source exports and signed reversals already available. Reverse discovery credit <- consent <- target <- average; forward handling average -> target -> user consent -> credit. One-hop entries and each problem's own handling documents establish every hop. Published “Internal: handling procedure for Managed Database signed invoice correction” also explicitly declares the four owned responsibilities and reference continuity; source correspondence will be assessed only after freeze.

Counter-proof. Doing only credit violates personal-consent condition. Mere unsigned request existence is excluded by “Its mere existence before filing is not consent.” Filing as agent violates “The customer alone files.” Using previous review 4100 is excluded by “Historical reviews with other references do not replace this newly reconstructed corrected total.” Averaging 5600 without reversal violates signed reversal and net aggregate rules. Replica and HA factors cannot be combined (“these choices are mutually exclusive”); approved negotiated rate takes no additional discount. Display-rounded average cannot be priced lossily because exact aggregate recovery is mandatory. Adding other invoices violates exact original-source scope, and implicit refund is expressly excluded. Blind conclusion: unique executable result, candidate runtime PASS pending GT comparison.

### documents.json[184] — Managed Database: personal correction authorization — prior signed corrections
## Assessment basis
Managed Database personal correction authorization uses the following prior signed corrections basis. Add signed posted correction credit and debit-adjustment amounts for the original source; service-credit concessions and correction entries of other source lines are excluded.

### documents.json[185] — Managed Database: personal correction authorization applicability
## Applicable business situation
Managed Database personal correction authorization is governed by these scope conditions. The linked resource count must be a positive integer within the database tier maximum resource count, and measured node-hours must fit the resource count and the actual source month. The approved negotiated rate for this route must be nonnegative and no greater than the standard tier unit rate; higher negotiated rates retain ordinary source-based correction handling. This signed credit workflow applies only when the reconstructed corrected gross target is strictly less than the original gross charge plus cumulative signed correction credits and debit adjustments for that exact source. Determine this comparison from the source evidence before selecting the workflow. Undercharges use the inherited positive-debit correction rule and equal corrected balances use its no-write rule; neither is handled by this credit workflow. This consolidated primary-export route applies where archive quantities are whole hundredths of a node-hour; finer export quantities retain the ordinary source-meter route. This branch handles a requested correction of one closed-period primary invoice for an on-demand, nonpromotional database contract below the portfolio threshold, with reviewed verified exempt tax treatment and a single active Managed Backup holding for the same customer and billing entity. The signed linked topology and the original source invoice both record the same resource count; all selected export records use that source and count. The historical source tier and configuration must match the current database contract. No other invoice line is included and no refund is implicit.

### documents.json[186] — Managed Database: personal correction authorization entry condition
## Handling condition
Managed Database personal correction authorization has this entry condition. Before correction consent is handled, primary target for the same original invoice source must be completed.

### documents.json[187] — Managed Database: personal correction authorization EU West rate basis
## Declared regional basis
Managed Database personal correction authorization retains a declared EU West regional multiplier of 1.12.

### documents.json[188] — Managed Database: handling personal correction authorization
## Business purpose
Managed Database personal correction authorization supports the requested account correction. The customer alone files the correction authorization after receiving the reviewed figure; use the customer-supplied external reference unchanged. Use the existing unsigned general request selected by the database holding authorization request reference, with original source reference matching the original invoice and the same exact external reference the customer supplies. This request is only an enquiry while source type is request and quantity is zero; it is not correction consent. Personal filing updates that same record in place to source type correction and the authorized amount, preserves its database occurrence reference and exact external reference, and links it to the approved current review. Do not create a second request record. Copy the preserved request identifier from the initial account query and confirm its signed status and amount in the actual customer filing receipt before posting the credit. Set source type correction, meter classification none, quantity unit USD, quantity equal to the authorized amount, status pending and filing time to the current handling clock. This correction authorization is not a service credit outage claim and therefore the conditional outage-claim deadline does not apply.

## Capability
Personally file a database invoice correction authorization for the stated amount. Update the existing unsigned request in place, linking it to the original charge and billing review and recording the customer's exact existing reference, authorized amount and current filing time. The request authorizes the customer's own account correction and does not itself change the balance.

## Invocation
The tool post_correction_consent_d1041c04 must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves.

## Parameters
- database_event_id: Reference — Identifier of the original database invoice charge record obtained from find_database_events.
- database_holding_id: Reference — Identifier of the database contract obtained from find_database_holdings.
- customer_id: Reference — Identifier of the verified enterprise customer profile obtained from find_customers.
- related_event_id: Reference — Identifier of the approved billing review record obtained from its receipt or find_database_events.
- request_id: Reference — Identifier of the existing unsigned request selected by the contract request_id, obtained from find_database_holdings and find_database_events.
- external_reference: Exact text — Copy the correction authorization reference supplied by the customer character for character, preserving wording, digits and punctuation with no translation, normalization, summarization, addition or deletion (verbatim).
- quantity: Decimal — Personally authorized correction amount; unit USD. Decimal quantity to six decimal places; monetary USD value limited to two decimal places, round half-up once at submission, no empty value.

## Successful return
String receipt with request_id (the existing request reference now personally signed), quantity (authorized USD amount to two decimals) and pending status, confirming immediate filing by the customer.

### documents.json[250] — Managed Database: primary per-node reconciliation — assessment outcome
## Assessment basis
Managed Database primary per-node reconciliation uses the following assessment outcome basis. Convert reconciled aggregate node-hours to an integer count of hundredths. With a positive topology count, multiply those hundredths by ten thousand to express millionths, divide by the topology count with exact integer quotient/remainder arithmetic, and round a half or larger remainder upward. Store the consequent integer millionths divided by one million as the six-decimal per-node average; zero topology returns zero and is not eligible for processing.

## Hypothetical calculation
Hypothetical inputs: aggregate usage is 1.00 node-hour across 3 nodes. The aggregate is 100 hundredths, or 1000000 millionths. Integer division by 3 gives 333333 with remainder 1; the remainder is below half the divisor. The recorded average is 0.333333 node-hour. For a hypothetical 0.01 node-hour across 32 nodes, the exact 312.5 millionths rounds upward to 313 millionths, giving 0.000313 node-hour.

### documents.json[260] — Managed Database: handling primary correction credit
## Business purpose
Managed Database primary correction credit supports the requested account correction. Post exactly one correction credit linked by original source reference to the original charge, linked evidence reference to the approved review, and authorization request reference to the customer correction authorization. Preserve prior service-credit concessions; a posted correction already attaining the target is read-only. Customer consent is mandatory for this signed correction route. The request identifier comes from the initial unsigned enquiry selected by the holding authorization request reference; require its real personal filing receipt and correction subtype before treating it as authorization. Its mere existence before filing is not consent.

## Capability
Post a tax-exempt database invoice correction credit. Create one posted credit with the supplied signed amount as both receivable change and pretax component, tax amount zero, attached to the original charge, approved review and customer authorization. The negative receivable change is immediately visible on the account.

## Invocation
post_primary_correction_900303b8 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

### documents.json[262] — Internal: handling procedure for Managed Database signed invoice correction
## Procedure situation
Managed Database: A customer requests correction of a closed-period verified-exempt primary database invoice whose reconstructed target is strictly less than its correction-adjusted original charge, with linked backup topology evidence. Completion leaves the corrected target, personal authorization and exact remaining overcharge credit recorded. Undercharges and equal balances retain their ordinary inherited correction handling outside this workflow.

## Ordered responsibilities
1. The agent performs primary quantity reconciliation using post_primary_average_31a3f059.
2. The agent completes the accountant review using post_primary_target_faf69343.
3. The customer themselves performs personal authorization using post_correction_consent_d1041c04.
4. The agent posts the invoice correction credit using post_primary_correction_900303b8.

## Reference continuity
The quantity assessment reference identifies the evidence consumed by the accountant review. The approved review reference identifies the decision attached to the customer authorization. The personally signed request reference identifies the authorization attached to the credit.

## Ordering basis
Primary quantity reconciliation precedes accounting review because the review consumes its per-node quantity. Review precedes customer authorization because the customer must be shown the authoritative corrected amount. Authorization precedes the invoice credit because this route requires the customer personally to authorize the exact remaining overcharge. All source exports exist before the call; calculations, customer filing and account posting execute synchronously without waiting.

## Roles in the procedure
The agent owns the quantity assessment, accountant review and credit posting. The customer themselves owns the personal filing.

## Ordering case
Hypothetical reversal of adjacent responsibilities: if customer authorization preceded the accountant review, the authoritative corrected amount would not yet be available to show the customer. If credit posting preceded personal authorization, the required personal authority for the exact remaining overcharge would be missing.

The equality requirement ensures the full remaining error is corrected in one entry.

## Hypothetical calculation

### documents.json[272] — Managed Database: current primary billing review — exact aggregate recovery
## Assessment basis
Managed Database current primary billing review uses the following exact aggregate recovery basis. Recover the exact aggregate hundredths from the completed per-node assessment before applying any price: express its six-decimal quantity as integer millionths, multiply by the topology count, and round that product to the nearest ten thousand millionths, with halves upward. This recovers the original archive aggregate exactly because its grain is a hundredth and resource count is within the declared tier maximum. The six-decimal display average is never used as a lossy billable quantity.

## Hypothetical recovery
Hypothetical inputs: a completed average is 0.333333 node-hour and the topology contains 3 nodes. The average is 333333 millionths; multiplying by 3 gives 999999 millionths. Rounding to the nearest 10000 millionths gives 1000000 millionths, or 100 hundredths. The billing aggregate is therefore 1.00 node-hour, rather than the unrounded product 0.999999.

### documents.json[273] — Managed Database: current primary billing review — database operating mode pricing
## Assessment basis
Managed Database current primary billing review uses the following database operating mode pricing basis. Multiply the node rate by high availability multiplier for high availability operating mode, read replica multiplier for replica operating mode, and one for standard operating mode; these choices are mutually exclusive.

## Configuration choice
| Configuration | Rate treatment |
|---|---|
| High availability | Apply the high availability multiplier |
| Replica | Apply the read replica multiplier |
| Standard | Leave the node rate unchanged |

These choices are mutually exclusive.

### documents.json[276] — Managed Database: handling current primary billing review
## Business purpose
Managed Database current primary billing review supports the requested account correction. The accountant completes the existing pending review linked to the per-node assessment, recording decision incorrect, status approved, the corrected net amount and zero tax amount.

## Capability
Record the accountant's corrected tax-exempt net invoice target in the specified database billing review. Replace its net amount, set tax amount to zero, status to approved and decision to incorrect. The approved review is authoritative evidence and changes no receivable balance.

## Invocation
post_primary_target_faf69343 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters
- database_event_id: Reference — Identifier of the database billing review record obtained from find_database_events.
- database_holding_id: Reference — Identifier of the reviewed database contract obtained from find_database_holdings.
- source_event_id: Reference — Identifier of the original invoice charge record obtained from find_database_events.
- related_event_id: Reference — Identifier of the usage evidence assessment record obtained from its completion receipt or find_database_events.
- net_amount: Decimal — Corrected pretax target; unit USD. USD to two decimals, round half-up once at submission, no empty value.

## Successful return
String receipt with database_event_id (review reference), net_amount (USD to two decimals), approved status and incorrect decision, confirming the corrected target has been recorded without posting money.

| Negotiated-price approval | Selected node price |
|---|---|
| Approved | The approved negotiated unit price, without another discount |
| Otherwise | The standard tier unit price |

### documents.json[280] — Managed Database: current primary billing review — assessment outcome
## Assessment basis
Managed Database current primary billing review uses the following assessment outcome basis. Express the selected node rate as integer millionths of a USD per node-hour, and each selected configuration and region factor as an integer count of hundredths; these are exact scale conversions of their declared decimal precisions. Multiply recovered aggregate hundredths by rate millionths, configuration hundredths and region hundredths to obtain an integer numerator in trillionths of USD. To round once to cents with decimal half-up, add five billion to that integer numerator, divide by ten billion with integer floor division, and divide the consequent integer cents by one hundred for the USD outcome. Reviewed verified exempt tax is zero.

## Hypothetical calculation
Hypothetical inputs: recovered aggregate quantity is 137 hundredths, selected rate is 125000 millionths of a USD, configuration is 195 hundredths and region is 104 hundredths. Their integer product is 347295000000 trillionths of USD. Adding 5000000000 and taking the integer quotient on division by 10000000000 gives 35 cents, or USD 0.35. Rounding the intermediate node price to cents before multiplying would change the basis; this clause rounds only the final service amount.

### documents.json[229] — Managed Database: source charge correction
## Governing clause
Managed Database source charge correction applies to database credit, database debit adjustment. For source type correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source type values. Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review net amount plus tax amount, following tax calculation. Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison. Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal. A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction. An upward correction carries positive amount. Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved. No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction. Link original source reference to the original charge and linked evidence reference to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines. Use gross correction amount from source correction and concession amounts for the correction comparison; net service concession amount never changes the approved corrected billing target.

## Evidence: approved correction
For source type correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source type values. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, original source reference, linked evidence reference, status, decision. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference, original source reference, linked evidence reference. 

## Hypothetical correction comparison
Hypothetical inputs: the original gross charge is USD 100, prior correction credits total USD 20, prior debit adjustments total USD 5 and the approved corrected gross amount is USD 70. The correction-adjusted gross amount is USD 85, leaving a USD 15 overcharge. The signed credit is negative USD 15. An independent service concession of USD 8 would not change this comparison.

## Account measurement
All posted credit and debit adjustment events through the current handling time for the exact original source reference. For the exact original charge original source reference, report gross correction amount as absolute correction credit amount less debit-adjustment amount, and net service concession amount as absolute pretax net amount of service-credit postings. Keep these two named components separate; tax is included only in gross correction amount, and unrelated source charges never enter either component.

### documents.json[238] — Managed Database: accountant source review
## Governing clause
Managed Database accountant source review applies to database review. The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object. A service accountant reviews one precise source event against its authoritative export, contract terms, bank notice, tax record or incident record. Record decision correct or incorrect for a billing review, and eligible or ineligible for an outage claim; status approved means the review is complete and authoritative, not that a credit necessarily follows. Record corrected net amount and tax amount for incorrect billing, or approved credit amount for an eligible outage after applying outage service credits. A rejected review cannot authorize money movement. The customer may provide a locator but cannot dictate an official decision. Repeating the same source and request review returns the existing decision; materially new evidence is a distinct review linked through linked evidence reference. Review alone books no money.

## Evidence: reviewable source
The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, original source reference, linked evidence reference, database contract reference. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference, original source reference, linked evidence reference, database contract reference.
